title: Downtown Luxury! | 7 minutes to Broadway | HotTub!
description:
Discover luxury and convenience in this BRAND new, stunning Downtown Nashville home! Centrally located, just 7 minutes from Broadway, it doesn't get any more convenient! With 4 bedrooms & 4.5 bathrooms, this home is perfect for mid-size and large groups. Enjoy modern decor, upscale brand new appliances, and a private rooftop hot tub! This sophisticated retreat promises a memorable stay, and an unforgettable Music City experience!

Book now and uncover everything Music City has to offer! ♪♫♪

The space
Experience the ultimate blend of luxury and modern comfort with our newly built Nashville home. Perfectly situated just minutes from the vibrant downtown and the lively nightlife of Broadway, this stunning four-level property is designed for large groups or families seeking an exceptional getaway.

Immerse yourself in a combination of style, convenience, and luxury. Here's what's in store for you:

᯽ Expansive Living Space: With 4 elegantly designed bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, this home comfortably sleeps up to 12 guests across 10 beds, offering ample space for everyone to unwind.
᯽ Private Rooftop Retreat: Unwind on your exclusive rooftop with a hot tub and comfortable seating. It's the perfect spot for relaxation and taking in stunning views of the city.
᯽ Sophisticated Design: The home boasts a professionally designed interior, combining trendy, high-end decor with state-of-the-art appliances, blending modern style with luxury.
᯽ Fully Equipped Kitchen: Cook up a feast in the fully equipped kitchen, complete with all the essentials and modern amenities to make dining a pleasure.
᯽ Entertainment Ready: Stay connected with high-speed WiFi, streaming services, and multiple luxury amenities designed for your entertainment.
᯽ Convenient Laundry: Enjoy the convenience of two free on-site washers and dryers, making laundry a breeze.
᯽ Parking Made Easy: Benefit from the convenience of free on-site parking, ensuring a hassle-free stay.
᯽ Coffee Perks: Start each day with a fresh cup of coffee from the provided coffee machine, along with complimentary coffee to suit your taste.
᯽ Prime Location: Explore Nashville effortlessly with downtown and Broadway being less than 10 minutes away, giving you quick access to the city’s top attractions.
᯽ Enhanced Security: Exterior cameras are installed for added security, ensuring a safe and worry-free stay.

Our bed arrangements are designed to offer maximum comfort and fit various group sizes, ensuring a pleasant and relaxing stay for all. Each bedroom comes with its own private bathroom, providing guests with the privacy they desire and making preparations for evening activities effortless!

᯽ Bedroom 1 (Second Floor): Features a cozy Queen bed, ideal for a restful night’s sleep.
᯽ Bedroom 2 (Second Floor): Offers 2 Twin over Twin bunk beds, perfect for families or groups needing extra sleeping space.
᯽ Bedroom 3 (Third Floor): Equipped with another Queen bed for added comfort.
᯽ Bedroom 4 (Third Floor): Includes 2 Twin over Twin bunk beds, ensuring ample room for everyone to sleep comfortably.

Important note: The Rooftop hot tub is serviced on Wednesdays, this is typically a quick process and occurs in the mid-afternoon, in order to ensure a sparkling clean hot tub for your stay. The company won't bother you at all, other than accessing the rooftop!

Explore the best of Nashville, with the city’s attractions just minutes away:

𖡡 Downtown Nashville - 2.2 miles 
𖡡 Broadway Nashville - 1.6 miles 
𖡡 Capitol View Shopping Center and Restaurants - 1.2 miles 
𖡡 The Gulch - 2 miles 
𖡡 Music City Center - 2.2 miles 
𖡡 Bridgestone Arena - 2.2 miles 
𖡡 Nissan Stadium - 2.6 miles 
𖡡 Nashville International Airport - 8.3 miles 
𖡡 Vanderbilt University - 1.2 miles 
𖡡 Belmont University - 2.4 miles

Whether you’re here to explore Nashville’s vibrant scene or simply to enjoy a luxurious retreat, our home offers the perfect setting for an unforgettable stay.

Book now and discover the finest of Music City!

Guest access
During your stay, you'll have full access to the entire home, guaranteeing a private and personalized experience. From the moment you arrive, the space is entirely yours to explore, relax, and make cherished memories. Enjoy the luxury of having no shared spaces or interruptions, allowing you to fully unwind and savor the comfort of having the whole home all to yourself!

Other things to note
ATTENTION LOCAL GUESTS: All locals must send an 'inquiry' first using the 'Contact Host' option on the booking page to state the purpose of your visit, so we can check to see if we would be able to accommodate your stay; otherwise, we reserve the right to cancel any confirmed reservation made without our approval.

There is a rental agreement that needs to be signed after each booking is confirmed. It will be sent over immediately after booking and can be signed digitally.
